request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Runehide Tortoise".

Creative brief
Name: Runehide Tortoise
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A defensive rune caster that activates different shell quadrants in sequence.
Body and silhouette: Broad low tortoise with a square-edged shell, thick legs, and a compact beaked head.
Signature features: Four large shell runes, glowing shell seams, and crystal brow plate.
Palette and materials: Slate blue, muted gold, cream stone, and luminous violet.
Movement personality: Slow, ancient, and perfectly methodical.
Attack concept: Illuminates one shell quadrant at a time before firing a fan of rune bolts from the corresponding side.
Directional details: The lower-left shell rune is incomplete.
Avoid: Ordinary turtle, microscopic writing, circular shell without readable quadrants.
